facts.text: Lincoln Park celebrated its 90th anniversary this year with the opening of Heritage Plaza, a new public space on the museum lawn.
The town’s first post office opened in 1921, when residents secured a branch from the Detroit Post Office to serve the new village.
Suburban Motor Car Company operated in Lincoln Park from 1911 to 1913, a brief but notable chapter in early automotive history.
Bill Morrison, a native of Lincoln Park, earned acclaim as an award‑winning illustrator and comic book artist, and he recently released a new piece titled “Made in Lincoln Park, MI.”.
The historic Lincoln Park Historical Museum hosts a new book, *Lost Lincoln Park*, which maps community landmarks that have changed or vanished over time.
Lincoln Park sits between West Wyomissing and Shillington, placing it in the heart of Montgomery County’s suburban landscape.
